The trees `pptx` reads from test presentations of
[python-pptx](https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx) (MIT, © 2013 Steve Canny),
which the Dart package draws in its tests. Written by
`go test ./pptx -run Fixtures -update` once the corpus is fetched.

`strict.pptx` and `transitional.pptx` hold the same content, written by hand
in Strict and in Transitional Open XML.
